title: School attendance obligation
question: Is school attendance compulsory for children in Poland?
short_answer: Yes. School attendance is compulsory from age 6 (preschool) to 18.
conditions: Age 6: compulsory preschool year (roczne przygotowanie przedszkolne)
Age 7–15: compulsory primary school (szkoła podstawowa, 8 years)
Foreign children residing in Poland are also subject to compulsory schooling
Enrolment must be at the school in the child's residential district (rejon)
exceptions: Home schooling (edukacja domowa) is permitted with approval from the school director
Special needs schools available for children with disabilities
penalties: Fines up to 5000 PLN for parents whose child repeatedly skips school
Local authority can impose enforcement measures on parents
